analysis.title: Does migration simply copy the KV cache?
analysis.body: It uses stateless in-flight migration: the destination reconstructs state from prompt/generated tokens and resumes after one re-prefill, guarded by costs, reservations, hop limits and post-migration checks. GRPODropout filters responses after generation using entropy contribution and generally does not save generation.
